artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the large dark bread loaf appears slightly 'mushy' or overly smooth in areas where a coarse crumb or crust would be expected. It lacks fine micro-detail compared to real photography.
The individual rings in the stack seem to merge into each other slightly at the contact points, lacking distinct separation shadows. This suggests minor fusion artifacts common in AI generation.
The parallel lines of the background shelving appear slightly warped or inconsistent with a rigid geometric structure, though this could also be due to lens distortion or depth of field.
